changes: An owned Linux worker supervises the calibration environment and HTTP threads; wall time includes startup.
Quote/provider timeouts use remaining time, with fresh deadline/stop checks before reservation and provider admission.
Existing reservations are never refunded when time or stop state is consumed after reservation.
Exclusive worker receipts record PID, exit, shutdown and deadline outcome; failed/late receipts cannot be overridden by a completion marker.
Local finish grading after failed episodes is stored separately and cannot supply valid reward variance or full-solve counts.
Already-terminal tool-budget failures retain their original reward rather than being regraded.
The replay profile remains locked before budget, credentials, tokenizer or provider access.

actual_local_process_checks: A stuck worker with four threads was killed at a 0.5-second bound; SIGKILL exit and stopped state were observed within 3 seconds, with the partial archive preserved.
A second worker blocked on actual localhost HTTP requests was killed and its shutdown observed under the same bound.
Normal exit, nonzero exit, sanitized exception and missing worker result remain distinct.
Existing receipt paths and invalid/unbounded limits are refused without overwriting archives.
gate_checks: Failed-episode terminal reward diagnostics cannot supply valid variance.
Timeout, late completion, failed exit, unverified shutdown, mismatched PID and incomplete receipts fail closed.
A completion marker cannot override a failed supervised receipt.

cases: Partial replay repair followed by invalid JSON, truncation or observation overflow retains failure and valid reward 0, with terminal diagnostic 0.5.
An already-terminal environment tool-budget failure is not regraded into a success.
Deadline consumption during quote/reservation and stop during reservation do not admit a provider call; existing reservations persist.
The CLI uses an owned supervised worker; mocked fixture execution does not access credentials or provider admission.
Failed full-reward rows are excluded from summary full solves.

limitations: Process shutdown is local evidence, not provider request cancellation or invoice verification.
The supervisor targets this in-process environment/HTTP worker, not arbitrary subprocess trees or remote jobs.
Local supervision depends on its parent remaining alive; parent-crash behavior is not attested by these tests.
Native grading/CLI cases still require the pinned-SDK CI; offline process checks are not model rollouts.
Hard-killed archives may lack terminal grading and remain incomplete.
Proxy checkpoint/thinking/Arena wrapper equivalence remains unattested.
The default eight-task mix and validated 7156868 review image remain unchanged.
